description: Use for the last 48 hours of crypto-only headlines: coins, tokens, exchanges and Binance announcements. For all markets use get_latest_news; for a past day use get_crypto_news_day. Labels can miss items. Recent crypto-labelled headlines with publisher, times, coin labels and AI scores where available: returns a JSON object with count and items. Call without payment to see the price and matching count; pay to get the records. Parameters combine as filters: limit: 1-100, default 50; coin: optional case-insensitive ticker; call list_supported_coins or GET /v1/coins for recent labels; tag: optional lower-case label; sentiment: optional positive, neutral, negative or unscored stored label; missing labels do not match; q: optional keyword search in headline titles, 2-60 characters; since: optional UTC timestamp ending Z; before: optional next_before cursor for the next older page; format: compact or omit for full fields. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Invalid, empty or stale requests are refused before payment. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.

before.description: Optional page cursor: pass next_before from the previous response to get the next older page of the same query. A response carries next_before while older matching records remain.

coin.description: Optional ticker such as BTC, ETH, NVDA or EURUSD, matched against the AI-tagged coins and the tickers named in each record. Call list_supported_coins or GET /v1/coins for recent labels.

format.description: Optional compact view: retain selected headline or market fields and omit other fields. Omit for the full response.

limit.description: Maximum records to return, 1 to 100. Default 50.

q.description: Optional keyword or phrase, 2 to 60 characters, matched case-insensitively in the headline title, such as ETF or rate cut. A paid request with no matching headline is refused before any charge.

sentiment.description: Optional stored sentiment label: positive, neutral, negative or unscored. Records without a stored label do not match, including unscored.

since.description: Optional UTC time such as 2026-11-13T09:00:00Z: only records first seen after it, so a bot polling every hour pays for new items only.

tag.description: Optional label to match, lower case: a ticker (btc, nvda, eurusd, xau), a topic or an event type (token_listing, etf_approval).

name: get_crypto_news
title: Pay: Crypto news by coin
